The date command printed Sat Oct 3 05:10:53 PM EDT 2026. That is a Saturday in early October, just after five in the afternoon. The zone label EDT means Eastern Daylight Time, four hours behind UTC.

Server clocks drift because hardware oscillators are imperfect and change speed with temperature, voltage, and age. Without regular correction from NTP or a similar time source, those small errors accumulate into seconds or minutes. Virtual machines add more skew when the host pauses them or when the guest cannot see a stable hardware clock.
